project_name: Treesh Music - Profile Avatar & Online Notifications System Blueprint

profile_tab_bottom_nav.container: relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer transition-all duration-200 py-1 px-3 rounded-full hover:bg-white/5 active:scale-95
profile_tab_bottom_nav.avatar_size_default: w-8 h-8 rounded-full object-cover ring-2 transition-all duration-300

nickname_label.style: text-[10px] font-medium tracking-wide mt-1 text-white/80 max-w-[64px] truncate transition-opacity duration-200

header_notifications_bell.button_style: relative w-11 h-11 rounded-full bg-white/[0.06] hover:bg-white/[0.12] active:scale-95 border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-200 text-white
header_notifications_bell.badge_style: absolute -top-1 -right-1 min-w-[18px] h-[18px] px-1 bg-[var(--treesh-purple)] text-white text-[10px] font-bold rounded-full flex items-center justify-center border-2 border-[#050509] animate-pulse shadow-lg
header_notifications_bell.dnd_indicator: absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-amber-500/90 border-2 border-[#050509] flex items-center justify-center text-[9px] text-black font-bold

online_activity_toast_banners.container_desktop: fixed top-[90px] right-6 z-[9990] w-[380px] flex flex-col gap-3 pointer-events-none
online_activity_toast_banners.container_mobile: fixed top-[84px] left-3 right-3 z-[9990] flex flex-col gap-2 pointer-events-none
online_activity_toast_banners.banner_item: pointer-events-auto relative w-full rounded-2xl p-4 bg-[#14111d]/95 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/[0.14] shadow-[0_12px_36px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6)] flex flex-col gap-2 transition-all duration-300 transform translate-x-0 ease-out hover:border-[var(--treesh-purple)]/50 touch-pan-x
online_activity_toast_banners.stacking_logic: Max 3 visible. Index 0 is front (opacity 1, scale 1), Index 1 is offset (scale 0.96, translate-y-[-8px], opacity 0.85), Index 2 is collapsed (scale 0.92, translate-y-[-16px], opacity 0.6)
online_activity_toast_banners.hairline_progress: absolute bottom-0 left-4 right-4 h-[2px] bg-[var(--treesh-purple)] opacity-80 rounded-full transition-all linear
online_activity_toast_banners.swipe_behavior: Swipe right or up > 80px triggers slide-out animation and dismissal

notifications_center_modal.overlay: fixed inset-0 z-[9998] bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md transition-opacity duration-300 opacity-100
notifications_center_modal.drawer_desktop: fixed top-4 bottom-4 right-4 z-[9999] w-[440px] rounded-3xl bg-[#14111d]/95 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/[0.14] shadow-[0_24px_64px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] flex flex-col overflow-hidden transition-transform duration-300 ease-out translate-x-0
notifications_center_modal.drawer_mobile: fixed top-[78px] bottom-[70px] left-2 right-2 z-[9999] rounded-2xl bg-[#14111d]/95 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/[0.14] shadow-2xl flex flex-col overflow-hidden transition-transform duration-300 ease-out translate-x-0
notifications_center_modal.header_section: p-5 border-b border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-white/[0.02]
notifications_center_modal.segmented_tabs: flex items-center gap-1 p-1.5 mx-5 my-3 bg-white/[0.04] rounded-xl border border-white/[0.06]
notifications_center_modal.tab_item_active: flex-1 py-1.5 px-3 text-xs font-semibold text-white bg-[var(--treesh-purple)] rounded-lg shadow-md transition-all duration-200 text-center flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5
notifications_center_modal.tab_item_inactive: flex-1 py-1.5 px-3 text-xs font-medium text-white/60 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/[0.05] rounded-lg transition-all duration-200 text-center flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5
notifications_center_modal.search_input: w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 bg-white/[0.05] border border-white/10 rounded-xl text-xs text-white placeholder-white/40 focus:outline-none focus:border-[var(--treesh-purple)] transition-all
notifications_center_modal.notification_row: relative group px-5 py-3.5 border-b border-white/[0.04] hover:bg-white/[0.04] transition-all flex items-start gap-3 cursor-pointer overflow-hidden

swipe_actions.swipe_left_delete: Absolute right reveal container with bg-rose-600 text-white font-medium flex items-center justify-end px-4 text-xs
swipe_actions.swipe_right_read: Absolute left reveal container with bg-[var(--treesh-purple)] text-white font-medium flex items-center justify-start px-4 text-xs

preferences_panel.container: p-5 flex flex-col gap-6 overflow-y-auto max-h-full
preferences_panel.setting_row: flex items-center justify-between p-3.5 bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/[0.06] rounded-xl hover:border-white/10 transition-all
preferences_panel.segmented_picker: inline-flex bg-white/[0.06] p-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 gap-1
preferences_panel.segmented_option_active: px-3 py-1 bg-[var(--treesh-purple)] text-white text-xs font-semibold rounded-md shadow-sm
preferences_panel.segmented_option_inactive: px-3 py-1 text-white/60 hover:text-white text-xs font-medium rounded-md transition-all
preferences_panel.toggle_switch: relative w-11 h-6 bg-white/20 rounded-full cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-200 data-[checked=true]:bg-[var(--treesh-purple)]
preferences_panel.toggle_thumb: absolute top-1 left-1 w-4 h-4 bg-white rounded-full transition-transform duration-200 data-[checked=true]:translate-x-5

general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: No centered text layout for notification panels or lists; left-align all row titles, descriptions, and action buttons.
Do not hardcode accent colors - always utilize var(--treesh-purple) with rgba alpha overlays or color-mix for states.
Maintain smooth performance on mobile: avoid heavy live backdrop-filter stacks on older mobile webkit engines.
All interactive buttons and key state elements MUST contain exact data-testid attributes for automated testing.
Banners and drawers must support full keyboard focus traps, Esc key dismissal, and touch swipe gestures.
